title: Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan Tier Structure and Tier Movement Terms
content:
The Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan has six tiers, ranked upward: Paystride Access Starter, Paystride Access Standard, Paystride Access Plus, Paystride Access Preferred, Paystride Access Premier and Paystride Access Premier Plus. The tier terms below concern movement between tiers.

| Tier | Tier steps dropped at the first level review after a shortfall | A write-off returns the plan to Paystride Access Starter | When the tier is reviewed | Most tiers moved up at one review |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paystride Access Starter | 0 | yes | each payday | 1 |
| Paystride Access Standard | 1 | yes | each payday | 1 |
| Paystride Access Plus | 1 | yes | each payday | 1 |
| Paystride Access Preferred | 1 | yes | each payday | 1 |
| Paystride Access Premier | 1 | yes | each payday | 1 |
| Paystride Access Premier Plus | 1 | yes | each payday | 1 |

## Definitions

- **Downgrade steps** — the tier steps the plan drops at the first level review after a shortfall (count).
- **Write-off reset** — whether a write-off returns the plan to Paystride Access Starter.
- **Review cadence** — when the plan tier is reviewed (text): each payday on every tier.
- **Upgrade steps** — the most tiers a plan may move up at one level review (count).

Downgrade steps are 0 on Paystride Access Starter and 1 on every other tier; a write-off reset, a review each payday and a one-tier upgrade limit hold on all six tiers.
